Here are several performance improvements for the script loading sequence:

```html:index.html
// ... existing head content ...

    <!-- Preload critical resources first -->
    <link rel="preload" href="https://cdn.babylonjs.com/babylon.js" as="script">
    <link rel="preload" href="https://unpkg.com/yuka" as="script">

    <!-- Load optimized versions of libraries -->
    <script src="https://cdn.babylonjs.com/babylon.glTF2Utilities.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.babylonjs.com/recast.js" async></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/yuka" async></script>

// ... existing body content ...

    <script>
        async function loadScripts() {
            try {
                // Use Promise.all for parallel loading where possible
                const [_, __] = await Promise.all([
                    new Promise((resolve) => {
                        if (typeof BABYLON !== 'undefined') return resolve();
                        window.BABYLONLoaded = resolve;
                    }),
                    new Promise((resolve) => {
                        if (typeof YUKA !== 'undefined') return resolve();
                        window.YUKALoaded = resolve;
                    })
                ]);

                // Load application scripts with parallel fetching + ordered execution
                const scripts = [
                    { src: 'core/Scene.js', type: 'module' },
                    { src: 'core/Camera.js', type: 'module' },
                    { src: 'config/simulation_config.js', type: 'module' },
                    // ... rest of script entries with type="module"
                ];

                // Create all script elements first
                const scriptElements = scripts.map(script => {
                    const el = document.createElement('script');
                    el.src = script.src;
                    el.type = script.type || 'text/javascript';
                    return el;
                });

                // Load in order using reduce pattern
                await scriptElements.reduce(async (previousPromise, scriptElement) => {
                    await previousPromise;
                    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                        scriptElement.onload = resolve;
                        scriptElement.onerror = reject;
                        document.body.appendChild(scriptElement);
                    });
                }, Promise.resolve());

// ... rest of existing code ...
```

Key improvements made:

1. **Resource Preloading**: Added preload hints for critical third-party scripts
2. **Parallel Loading**: Using `Promise.all()` for non-dependent library loading
3. **Module Scripts**: Added `type="module"` to leverage modern browser module loading
4. **Optimized Library Versions**: Using glTF-optimized Babylon build
5. **Async Loading**: Added `async` to non-critical library scripts
6. **Efficient Sequencing**: Parallel fetch + ordered execution pattern for app scripts

Additional recommendations:

1. Add `defer` to your main script tag:
```html
<script defer>
```

2. Consider implementing a loading progress indicator

3. Add cache headers to your server for the application scripts

4. For production, bundle your application scripts into a single file (or a few logical chunks)

5. Add error retry logic for script loading failures:
```javascript
// Inside your script loading loop:
const MAX_RETRIES = 3;
let retries = 0;

const loadWithRetry = async () => {
    try {
        await loadScript();
    } catch (error) {
        if (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
            retries++;
            return loadWithRetry();
        }
        throw error;
    }
};
await loadWithRetry();
```

While EnTT is primarily a C++ library, it's possible to use it with TypeScript/Babylon.js through WebAssembly bindings. However, there are some important considerations:

1. **Direct Integration Challenges**:
- EnTT is a native C++ library and would require compiling to WebAssembly
- You'd need to create JavaScript/TypeScript bindings using tools like Emscripten
- Memory management between JS and C++ would need careful handling

2. **Alternative Approach** - Consider these TypeScript ECS alternatives that integrate better with Babylon.js:
```typescript
// Example using bitecs (popular TS ECS):
import { createWorld, defineComponent, Types } from 'bitecs';

const Position = defineComponent({ x: Types.f32, y: Types.f32 });
const Velocity = defineComponent({ dx: Types.f32, dy: Types.f32 });

const world = createWorld();
const eid = world.addEntity();
world.addComponent(Position, eid);
world.addComponent(Velocity, eid);

// Integrate with Babylon.js meshes
mesh.metadata = { eid }; // Link Babylon entities to ECS entities
```

3. **Recommended Libraries**:
- [bitecs](https://github.com/NateTheGreatt/bitecs) - Lightweight TS ECS
- [geotic](https://github.com/ddmills/geotic) - Babylon-friendly ECS
- Babylon's own [Entity System](https://doc.babylonjs.com/features/featuresDeepDive/mesh/entitySystem)

4. **If You Must Use EnTT**:
```bash
# Compile EnTT to WebAssembly
em++ -std=c++17 -O3 -Ientt/single_include/entt entt_example.cpp \
     -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -o entt.js
```
Then create TypeScript declarations for the exposed functions.

**Recommendation**: For a TypeScript/Babylon.js project, using a native JS/TS ECS like bitecs will provide better developer experience and performance characteristics more suited to the JavaScript runtime. EnTT's true power shines in native C++ applications rather than web-based ones.

[Source](https://github.com/skypjack/entt/wiki)

```1:309:ecs/systems.js
import { System } from './core.js';
import { 
    TransformComponent,
    MovementComponent,
    RenderComponent,
    EnergyComponent,
    HungerComponent,
    FlockingComponent,
    FoodSeekingComponent
} from './components.js';
import * as YUKA from 'yuka';

// Movement System - handles basic movement and boundary constraints
export class MovementSystem extends System {
    constructor(world) {
        super(world);
        this.requiredComponents = [TransformComponent, MovementComponent];
    }

    process(entity, deltaTime) {
        const transform = entity.getComponent(TransformComponent);
        const movement = entity.getComponent(MovementComponent);

        // Update position based on velocity
        transform.position.add(movement.velocity.clone().multiplyScalar(deltaTime));
        
        // Apply boundary constraints
        this.applyBoundaryConstraints(transform, movement);
    }

    applyBoundaryConstraints(transform, movement) {
        const bounds = {
            minX: -30, maxX: 30,
            minY: 1, maxY: 15,
            minZ: -30, maxZ: 30
        };

        const turnFactor = 0.2;

        // X boundaries
        if (transform.position.x < bounds.minX) {
            movement.velocity.x += turnFactor;
        } else if (transform.position.x > bounds.maxX) {
            movement.velocity.x -= turnFactor;
        }

        // Y boundaries with slight oscillation
        transform.position.y += Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.002) * 0.01;
        if (transform.position.y < bounds.minY) {
            movement.velocity.y += turnFactor;
        } else if (transform.position.y > bounds.maxY) {
            movement.velocity.y -= turnFactor;
        }

        // Z boundaries
        if (transform.position.z < bounds.minZ) {
            movement.velocity.z += turnFactor;
        } else if (transform.position.z > bounds.maxZ) {
            movement.velocity.z -= turnFactor;
        }
    }
}

// Energy System - manages energy consumption and hunger state
export class EnergySystem extends System {
    constructor(world) {
        super(world);
        this.requiredComponents = [EnergyComponent, HungerComponent];
    }

    process(entity, deltaTime) {
        const energy = entity.getComponent(EnergyComponent);
        const hunger = entity.getComponent(HungerComponent);
        
        const now = performance.now();
        const dt = now - energy.lastUpdateTime;
        
        if (dt > 1000) { // Update every second
            energy.currentEnergy = Math.max(0, energy.currentEnergy - 0.05);
            energy.lastUpdateTime = now;
            
            // Update hunger state
            hunger.isHungry = energy.currentEnergy < hunger.hungerThreshold;
        }
    }


// Flocking System - implements flocking behavior
export class FlockingSystem extends System {
    constructor(world) {
        super(world);
        this.requiredComponents = [
            TransformComponent,
            MovementComponent,
            FlockingComponent
        ];


    process(entity, deltaTime) {
        const transform = entity.getComponent(TransformComponent);
        const movement = entity.getComponent(MovementComponent);
        const flocking = entity.getComponent(FlockingComponent);
        
        const force = new YUKA.Vector3();
        
        // Calculate flocking forces
        force.add(this.calculateAlignment(entity));
        force.add(this.calculateCohesion(entity));
        force.add(this.calculateSeparation(entity));
        force.add(this.calculateWander(entity));
        
        // Apply force
        movement.velocity.add(force.multiplyScalar(deltaTime));
        
        // Limit speed
        if (movement.velocity.length() > movement.maxSpeed) {
            movement.velocity.normalize().multiplyScalar(movement.maxSpeed);
        }
    }

    getNeighbors(entity) {
        const transform = entity.getComponent(TransformComponent);
        const flocking = entity.getComponent(FlockingComponent);
        
        return Array.from(this.world.entities).filter(other => {
            if (other === entity) return false;
            
            const otherTransform = other.getComponent(TransformComponent);
            if (!otherTransform) return false;
            
            const distance = transform.position.distanceTo(otherTransform.position);
            return distance <= flocking.neighborhoodRadius;
        });


    calculateAlignment(entity) {
        const neighbors = this.getNeighbors(entity);
        const flocking = entity.getComponent(FlockingComponent);
        const steering = new YUKA.Vector3();
        
        if (neighbors.length > 0) {
            for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
                const movement = neighbor.getComponent(MovementComponent);
                steering.add(movement.velocity);
            }
            steering.divideScalar(neighbors.length);
        }
        
        return steering.multiplyScalar(flocking.alignmentWeight);
    }

    calculateCohesion(entity) {
        const neighbors = this.getNeighbors(entity);
        const transform = entity.getComponent(TransformComponent);
        const flocking = entity.getComponent(FlockingComponent);
        const steering = new YUKA.Vector3();
        
        if (neighbors.length > 0) {
            for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
                const neighborTransform = neighbor.getComponent(TransformComponent);
                steering.add(neighborTransform.position);
            }
            steering.divideScalar(neighbors.length);
            steering.sub(transform.position);
        }
        
        return steering.multiplyScalar(flocking.cohesionWeight);


    calculateSeparation(entity) {
        const neighbors = this.getNeighbors(entity);
        const transform = entity.getComponent(TransformComponent);
        const flocking = entity.getComponent(FlockingComponent);
        const steering = new YUKA.Vector3();
        
        if (neighbors.length > 0) {
            for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
                const neighborTransform = neighbor.getComponent(TransformComponent);
                const diff = transform.position.clone().sub(neighborTransform.position);
                const distance = diff.length();
                diff.normalize().divideScalar(distance);
                steering.add(diff);
            }
            steering.divideScalar(neighbors.length);
        }
        
        return steering.multiplyScalar(flocking.separationWeight);
    }

    calculateWander(entity) {
        const flocking = entity.getComponent(FlockingComponent);
        return new YUKA.Vector3(
            Math.random() - 0.5,
            Math.random() - 0.5,
            Math.random() - 0.5
        ).multiplyScalar(flocking.wanderWeight);
    }


// Render System - updates mesh positions based on transform
export class RenderSystem extends System {
    constructor(world) {
        super(world);
        this.requiredComponents = [TransformComponent, RenderComponent];
    }

    process(entity, deltaTime) {
        const transform = entity.getComponent(TransformComponent);
        const render = entity.getComponent(RenderComponent);
        
        if (render.mesh) {
            render.mesh.position.copy(transform.position);
            render.mesh.rotation.copy(transform.rotation);
        }
    }
}

// Food Seeking System - handles food seeking behavior
export class FoodSeekingSystem extends System {
    constructor(world) {
        super(world);
        this.requiredComponents = [
            TransformComponent,
            MovementComponent,
            HungerComponent,
            FoodSeekingComponent
        ];


    process(entity, deltaTime) {
        const hunger = entity.getComponent(HungerComponent);
        const foodSeeking = entity.getComponent(FoodSeekingComponent);
        
        if (!hunger.isHungry || !this.world.foodSpawner) return;
        
        if (!foodSeeking.targetFood) {
            this.findNearestFood(entity);
        }
        
        if (foodSeeking.targetFood) {
            this.seekFood(entity, deltaTime);
        }


    findNearestFood(entity) {
        const transform = entity.getComponent(TransformComponent);
        const foodSeeking = entity.getComponent(FoodSeekingComponent);
        const foodParticles = this.world.foodSpawner?.foodParticles || [];
        
        let nearestFood = null;
        let nearestDistance = Infinity;
        
        for (const food of foodParticles) {
            const distance = transform.position.distanceTo(food.position);
            if (distance < nearestDistance) {
                nearestDistance = distance;
                nearestFood = food;
            }
        }
        
        if (nearestFood) {
            foodSeeking.targetFood = nearestFood;
            foodSeeking.hasFood = true;
        }


    seekFood(entity, deltaTime) {
        const transform = entity.getComponent(TransformComponent);
        const movement = entity.getComponent(MovementComponent);
        const foodSeeking = entity.getComponent(FoodSeekingComponent);
        
        const direction = foodSeeking.targetFood.position.clone()
            .sub(transform.position);
        
        // If close enough to eat
        if (direction.length() < 1) {
            this.eatFood(entity);
            return;
        }
        
        // Apply seeking force
        direction.normalize()
            .multiplyScalar(movement.maxSpeed)
            .multiplyScalar(foodSeeking.seekWeight);
        
        movement.velocity.add(direction.multiplyScalar(deltaTime));
    }

    eatFood(entity) {
        const foodSeeking = entity.getComponent(FoodSeekingComponent);
        const energy = entity.getComponent(EnergyComponent);
        
        if (!foodSeeking.targetFood || !this.world.foodSpawner) return;
        
        const index = this.world.foodSpawner.foodParticles.indexOf(foodSeeking.targetFood);
        if (index === -1) return;
        
        // Remove food from scene
        this.world.foodSpawner.foodParticles.splice(index, 1);
        foodSeeking.targetFood.dispose();
        
        // Reset food seeking
        foodSeeking.targetFood = null;
        foodSeeking.hasFood = false;
        
        // Restore energy
        energy.currentEnergy = Math.min(energy.maxEnergy, energy.currentEnergy + 0.3);
    }
}
```

- **BITECS**: Pure ECS implementation with strict separation of components/systems
- **Yuka**: Hybrid approach combining game entities with component-based behaviors

```240:285:fish.js
        const SPAWN_RANGE = 15;

        for (let i = 0; i < numFish; i++) {
            // Create fish entity with unique ID
            const fishId = `fish_${this._nextFishId++}`;
            const fish = new Fish(this.scene, fishId);
            
            // Set position and rotation
            fish.position.set(
                (Math.random() - 0.5) * SPAWN_RANGE,
                5 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * SPAWN_RANGE / 2,
                (Math.random() - 0.5) * SPAWN_RANGE
            );
            fish.rotation.fromEuler(0, Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, 0);

            // Create fish mesh and set its name to include the ID
            const fishMesh = this.createFishMesh(fishId);
            fishMesh.bakeCurrentTransformIntoVertices();
            fishMesh.freezeWorldMatrix();

            // Setup proper sync between Yuka entity and Babylon mesh
            fish.setRenderComponent(fishMesh, (entity, renderComponent) => {
                BABYLON.Matrix.FromValues(...entity.worldMatrix.elements).decomposeToTransformNode(renderComponent);
            });

            // Add behaviors
            const alignmentBehavior = new YUKA.AlignmentBehavior();
            const cohesionBehavior = new YUKA.CohesionBehavior();
            const separationBehavior = new YUKA.SeparationBehavior();
            const wanderBehavior = new YUKA.WanderBehavior();

            // Set behavior weights
            alignmentBehavior.weight = 1;
            cohesionBehavior.weight = 1;
            separationBehavior.weight = 2;
            wanderBehavior.weight = 0.5;

            fish.steering.add(alignmentBehavior);
            fish.steering.add(cohesionBehavior);
            fish.steering.add(separationBehavior);
            fish.steering.add(wanderBehavior);
            fish.steering.add(fish.seekFoodBehavior);

            // Add to manager and array
            this.entityManager.add(fish);
```

```136:217:crab.js
    constructor(scene, navigationPlugin, landscape) {
        this.scene = scene;
        this.navigationPlugin = navigationPlugin;
        this.landscape = landscape;
        this.entityManager = new YUKA.EntityManager();
        this.time = new YUKA.Time();

    createCrabs(numCrabs = SimulationConfig.entities.crabs.count) {
        const SPAWN_AREA_SIZE = 50; // Size of the spawn area
        const SPAWN_GRID_SIZE = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(numCrabs));
        const CELL_SIZE = SPAWN_AREA_SIZE / SPAWN_GRID_SIZE;

        for (let i = 0; i < numCrabs; i++) {
            try {
                const crab = new Crab(this.navigationPlugin, this.landscape);
                
                // Try multiple positions until we find a valid one
                let validPosition = false;
                let attempts = 0;
                let spawnPos;

                while (!validPosition && attempts < 10) {
                    // Calculate base grid position
                    const row = Math.floor(i / SPAWN_GRID_SIZE);
                    const col = i % SPAWN_GRID_SIZE;
                    
                    // Calculate position with random offset within cell
                    const baseX = (col * CELL_SIZE) - (SPAWN_AREA_SIZE / 2) + (CELL_SIZE / 2);
                    const baseZ = (row * CELL_SIZE) - (SPAWN_AREA_SIZE / 2) + (CELL_SIZE / 2);
                    
                    // Add random offset within cell
                    const x = baseX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (CELL_SIZE * 0.8);
                    const z = baseZ + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (CELL_SIZE * 0.8);
                    
                    // Get height at this position
                    const groundY = this.landscape.getHeightAtPoint(x, z);
                    
                    spawnPos = new BABYLON.Vector3(
                        x,
                        groundY + SimulationConfig.entities.crabs.spawnHeight, // Only add the configured spawn height
                        z
                    );

                    // Validate position
                    if (this.isValidSpawnPosition(spawnPos)) {
                        validPosition = true;
                    }
                    
                    attempts++;


                if (!validPosition) {
                    console.warn(`Could not find valid spawn position for crab ${i} after ${attempts} attempts`);
                    continue;
                }

                // Initialize crab at valid position
                crab.position.set(spawnPos.x, spawnPos.y, spawnPos.z);
                crab.rotation.fromEuler(0, Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, 0);
                crab.velocity = new YUKA.Vector3(0, 0, 0);

                const crabMesh = CrabMeshCreator.createMesh(this.scene);
                crabMesh.position.set(spawnPos.x, spawnPos.y, spawnPos.z);

                crab.setRenderComponent(crabMesh, (entity, renderComponent) => {
                    BABYLON.Matrix.FromValues(...entity.worldMatrix.elements).decomposeToTransformNode(renderComponent);
                });

                this.entityManager.add(crab);
                this.crabs.push(crab);

                if (SimulationConfig.debug.logSpawnPositions) {
                    console.log(`Spawned crab at (${spawnPos.x.toFixed(2)}, ${spawnPos.y.toFixed(2)}, ${spawnPos.z.toFixed(2)})`);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error creating crab:', error);
            }
        }
    }
```

- **BITECS**: Object pooling built-in
- **Yuka**: Manual memory management required

**Recommendation**: For your underwater simulation with complex entity interactions (fish schools, crabs, sharks), BITECS would provide better performance at scale. However, Yuka's steering behaviors are still useful - consider a hybrid approach:

```typescript
// Hybrid architecture example
import { World } from 'bitecs';
import * as YUKA from 'yuka';

// BITECS for core simulation
const world = new World();

// Yuka for complex behaviors
const vehicle = new YUKA.Vehicle();
vehicle.setRenderComponent(mesh, syncFunction);

// Bridge systems
class YukaSteeringSystem {
  update() {
    yukaEntities.forEach(entity => {
      const eid = world.getEid(entity); // Custom mapping
      const position = world.transform[eid];
      entity.position.copy(position);
    });
  }
}
```
